observations: Three photos show a black PlayStation 4 console with a custom black-and-white abstract design on the top cover.
The console is accompanied by a black DualShock 4 controller, a UK-style 3-pin power plug, and a USB cable.
The console has a visible seam or gap along the top edge, suggesting a custom skin or modification.
The controller appears to be standard PS4, with no visible damage or wear.
The power cable is a UK plug, which may not be compatible with Nigerian outlets without an adapter.
No disc drive is visible, which is typical for PS4 Slim or PS4 Pro models, but the exact model cannot be confirmed.
No branding or model number is visible on the console or controller in any photo.
The seller claims 'hacked' and '10 perfect games installed', but no evidence of this is shown in the photos.
The photos are taken on a white cloth background, with watermarks from 'KEVIN VIDEOS GAMES' and 'SHOT ON REDMI 7'.
